dimensionFindings.finding: The candidate treats a communal Open House, a realized installation that made elapsed time physical, and photograph browsing through movement across rooms as embodied ways of investigating time, attention, representation, and participation rather than reducing inquiry to prose.

The ten-day duration and the statement that Jamie “tended” a communal Open House make sustained presence legible, while attention, atmosphere, participation, care, people, relationships, and place establish the conditions of hospitality as part of the practice.

The passage supplies a ten-day duration, a realized installation translating elapsed time into physical experience, an interface combining social-network analysis with image comparison, and a proposal involving online photographs and movement through physical rooms. It also repairs the prior maturity collapse by distinguishing the realized installation, the interface prototype, and the co-designed documented proposal.

The first-person artistic-lineage framing connects the bounded early specimens to civic, technical, and organizational work through a continuing inquiry into people, materials, relationships, and place. It proposes continuity without claiming that every later project was directly caused by the earlier work.

A general reader can see relevance to Jamie's civic, technical, and organizational practice, yet the explicit value beyond organizational utility and the emphasis on attention, atmosphere, participation, representation, and care preserve artistic and relational value on their own terms.
